of.needed: complete list of managed resource kinds in use across the environment

original.statement: Crossplane v2 makes all managed resources namespaced, enabling namespace-scoped resource isolation instead of cluster-wide scoping.

decision.reason: [ev-914f3976650c] is only a suggestion under "Start using v2 features" to try a getting-started guide. It describes no change that leaves an environment exposed. [ev-f9df8ec77b1f] shows the s3.aws.m.upbound.io/v1beta1 Bucket only as an example of what a new namespaced MR looks like. Using it as the exposure flags environments that have already adopted the feature, not ones affected by a change. The undecidable operand is too vague to be a real condition, and the excerpts don't say what happens to existing cluster-scoped MRs, so they don't support a correct exposure condition.
